		}

		COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord = {
			picture = international_treaty
			allowed_civil_war = { always = yes }
			on_remove = {
				log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Idea COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord removed"
			}
			modifier = {
				research_speed_factor = 0.04
				productivity_growth_modifier = 0.01

				receiving_investment_cost_modifier = 0.03
			}
		}

		COLDWAR_PAK_deal_peaceful_atom_accord_CHI = {
